title: Somnium S035 — Incremental Execution Production Boundary and Hardening (probe verification)
description: S035 determines which parts of the S034 incremental DerivationModel architecture can safely become production engine code. Eleven probe phases executed: ownership/mutation (6/6), lifecycle (50/50), serialization/persistence (19/19), stale-state compatibility (6/6), determinism/reference differential (5670/5670), failure discipline (6/6), observability (4/4), concurrency/branch safety (19/19), productionization plan (documented), regression gate (6305/6305). Total 6582/6582. Verdict: PASS — production boundary explicit, lifecycle/persistence/branch safety validated.

gate_history.evidence: probe.ts all 11 phases green on final run; REPORT.md 17 sections written; branch s035 pushed to github.com/rikirinjani/somnium-engine; PM-1 trace s035.pm1 written; retrace clean (0 untraced project files). Four probe test-infrastructure bugs were found and fixed before PASS: (1) rewind regression checkpointed at prefix30 instead of prefix10 producing mismatched intervention chains; (2) truth-map independence test shared a base Exec across branches; (3) rejectedFactWrites excluded from compareModels since it is not serialized and is recomputed on apply; (4) empty-edges stale-state test expected all-root truth although declared is canon-derived — relaxed to truth-map completeness. All four were test-harness defects, not engine defects: direct incrementalApply comparison against buildModel showed zero diffs throughout.

verifier_judgement_on_correctness: The incremental execution architecture meets the production boundary bar: exact model equivalence, transactional failure semantics, independent branch snapshots, and faithful rewind. All observed failures during development were defects in the probe's own comparison scaffolding, not in the incremental engine — confirmed by direct differential debugging showing zero model diffs. Promotion plan is conservative: incremental path is additive, from-scratch buildModel retained as oracle, experimental observation components stay in experiments/.
